round_8.resolution: Repaired G0 bootstrap selection/approval/failure/closure reachability, all blocked-state amendment routes, action-boundary expiry margin, execution root, canonical handoff schema, exact tracker labels/dependencies/review refs/canonical digests, and current STATE counts/identity.

round_9.resolution: Defined an executable per-mutation action wrapper with 900-second freshness/source/worktree/sequence checks before every GitHub/Beads command; added a digest-bound closure-preflight and approval path with exact executable validation and live receipt check; made the STATE-only review candidate exception and post-review STATE commit sequence explicit.

round_10.resolution: Routed initial partial recovery back through implementation/postcheck/review; added typed closure failure/reconciliation paths; installed an executable per-command live-authority/partial-graph wrapper with unique receipts; bound closure-time status, closed-schema review, post/salvage/source/live graph semantics and live receipt; required distinct approvals/review files; and made G2 prove the exact live-closed G0 receipt.

round_11.resolution: Installed fixed no-argument closed-policy validators and canonical paths; persisted all-issues per-command snapshots and receipts in hard-coded register order; made pre/post/closure/G2 graph and record semantics exact; introduced receipt-pending and terminal-handoff states; added typed closure and handoff failure/recovery contracts; committed only salvage plus destination-closed STATE under a clean manifest; and made G2 independently validate the full closure/handoff chain.

round_12.resolution: Excluded schema_version from cross-schema approval binding; kept tracked STATE clean through success and recovery; added attempt-specific command receipts/outcomes plus fixed initial-recovery validators; introduced committed and result-validated terminal states; made postcommit recovery reconstruct external records without recreating the commit; added full invalidation routes; bound destination STATE packet IDs; and expanded G2 to dereference the complete closure, terminal-result, State, and all-issues graph chain.

round_13.resolution: Made the single recovery an exact attempt-2 suffix with retained attempt-1 failure evidence; classified applied-but-nonzero and non-applied outcomes from all-issues snapshots; added fixed-path recovery and graph evidence; tightened unique labels, dependency edges, receipts, snapshots, and action-result bindings; made closure-chain paths canonical and non-symlink; and added independent G2 validators for the mutation receipt/outcome chain and old-head salvage partition.

round_14.resolution: Anchored the immutable first-action preflight; made every protected command, G0 issue closure, and Beads push an atomic no-replace runner-owned operation; bound canonical argv, fixed snapshots, writer/time/output evidence, exact result schemas, and before/after transition semantics into postcheck and G2; admitted the exact non-applied attempt-1 recovery case; canonicalized all dynamic authority paths before load; and enforced independent reviewer role/run identities.

round_15.resolution: Fixed the non-applied recovery NameError; made final preflight validation and anchor/ledger genesis one byte-stable operation; moved approval/source/worktree/graph checks inside mutation and closure runners; anchored all critical I/O to no-follow root descriptors; ledger-bound artifact device/inode/digests and run identities; sealed closure and terminal results; and replaced weak Dolt status evidence with authenticated origin fetch plus equal local/remote revision proof.

round_16.resolution: Bound the preflight review literal and fixed verdict paths to round 17; gave every result validator a fresh process-local UUID; atomically rejected reused ledger run identities before every mutation and at append; required pairwise uniqueness in G0/G2; and made the failed attempt-1 post snapshot byte-identical to the attempt-2 retry pre snapshot.

round_17.resolution: Made the recovery snapshot the actual attempt-2 boundary artifact; moved every boundary, recovery-result, and closure-status write to root-FD no-follow exclusive I/O; rejected operational overlap with all approval, reviewer, author, actor, and ledger identities; gave the closure and terminal push runners executable fixed-schema failure producers; and expanded terminal failure evidence with push/fetch results and observed local/remote revisions.

round_18.resolution: Installed a separate anchored failure ledger with pre-mutation closure and push start rows; bound success and failure records to the start-row digest, writer, and run identity; made provider and subprocess observations total through nullable fields and caught error classes; added restart sealing without mutation replay; and extended exact-hash records and authority guards with distinct review-run and author identities.

round_19.resolution: Made STATE source identity describe the current reviewed planning checkout; added immutable attempt-2 failure and writer-preflight slots; made closure and terminal producers total across post-mutation evidence-write and ledger-append failures; preserved each failure kind through restart; made failure validators require non-success outcomes; and made G0/G2 replay both anchored ledgers with exact action/kind bindings, orphan-start rejection, fallback-row sealing, and success-row provenance.

round_20.resolution: Changed existing-record restart seals to use the immutable record's base runner identity instead of the already-used start-row identity; routed every failure-ledger publication through an explicit exit-74 no-replay hold; made the publication validators accept only one authenticated orphan start with optional matching failure record and writer-error row; and corrected G2 writer-error key derivation to the base runner identity.

round_21.resolution: Embedded a read-only canonical recovery freshness validator in the initial attempt-2 mutation runner; made closure and terminal runners rerun recovery approval and reconciliation validators at the mutation boundary; bound optional recovery approval IDs and digests into success and failure records; and added an authenticated terminal commit intent/start/completion protocol that covers render, commit, manifest, and pre-push validation crashes before the Beads push start.

round_22.resolution: Made the terminal-intent writer itself reopen and validate the fixed closure preflight, approval, postcheck, and result; fetch and bind the complete base/merge/head/tree identity; made recovery approval carry and revalidate the complete observed source identity inside the push runner; and gave every commit-phase exception or interruption an explicit supervised orphan-start route, validator-proven no-replay hold, and same-identity exact reconciliation path.

round_23.resolution: Regenerated the state-handoff and nested initial-anchor validators for the current review round; made the intent runner execute all canonical closure/post validators; standardized the canary-bound six-reference start row across producer, push, G0, and G2; added an executable root-anchored terminal-commit failure writer with immutable failure/observation evidence and bounded writer-error/orphan handling; and made reconciliation plus push validate and reuse the original intent runner identity.

round_24.resolution: Made interruption restart preserve an existing terminal failure record's original stage and append only its missing observation; made source identity mandatory before both predecessor and manifest hold branches and fully validated the manifest/parent/head/tree/two-file commit; and moved complete operational-versus-authority identity rejection inside intent before canary/start and inside the original-runner reconciliation/push gate.
